# Amazon.ae
> Amazon.ae is Amazon’s United Arab Emirates marketplace for shopping products, managing orders, memberships, payments, and customer services.

Amazon.ae provides localized shopping for UAE customers across retail categories including electronics, fashion, grocery, home, beauty, books, and everyday essentials, with services such as Prime, Fresh, deals, gift cards, and account management.

## Shopping & Discovery
- [Amazon.ae Home](https://www.amazon.ae/): Main UAE storefront for browsing products, categories, recommendations, and promotions.
- [Best Sellers](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/bestsellers): Popular products ranked by sales across major shopping categories.
- [New Releases](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/new-releases): Recently launched and newly trending products across departments.
- [Movers and Shakers](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/movers-and-shakers): Products gaining popularity fastest based on recent sales changes.
- [Deals](https://www.amazon.ae/deals): Time-limited discounts, featured offers, and promotional shopping events.
- [Gift Ideas](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/most-gifted): Frequently gifted products across categories and occasions.
- [Amazon Outlet](https://www.amazon.ae/outlet): Discounted overstock and clearance items across multiple departments.

## Prime & Membership
- [Amazon Prime](https://www.amazon.ae/prime): Prime membership overview with delivery, entertainment, and shopping benefits.
- [Prime Sign-up](https://www.amazon.ae/amazonprime): Membership enrollment page for Amazon Prime in the UAE.
- [Prime Video](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/video/storefront): Streaming destination for included and rentable video content.
- [Prime Help](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=G6LDPN7YJHYKH2J6): Help information about Prime benefits, billing, and membership management.

## Grocery & Everyday Essentials
- [Amazon Fresh Learn More](https://www.amazon.ae/fmc/learn-more): Overview of grocery delivery, selection, and Fresh shopping benefits.
- [Grocery Store](https://www.amazon.ae/grocery): Grocery shopping destination for pantry, beverages, and household essentials.
- [Health, Household & Personal Care](https://www.amazon.ae/s?i=hpc): Health, cleaning, wellness, and personal care products.
- [Pet Supplies](https://www.amazon.ae/s?i=pets): Food, accessories, and care products for pets.

## Product Categories
- [Electronics](https://www.amazon.ae/electronics-store/b/?ie=UTF8&node=15415001031): Consumer electronics, accessories, audio, and devices.
- [Computers](https://www.amazon.ae/s?i=computers): Laptops, components, peripherals, storage, and computer accessories.
- [Mobile Phones](https://www.amazon.ae/s?i=mobile): Smartphones, accessories, and mobile-related products.
- [Fashion](https://www.amazon.ae/fashion): Clothing, shoes, watches, jewelry, and accessories.
- [Beauty](https://www.amazon.ae/s?i=beauty): Skincare, cosmetics, fragrances, and beauty tools.
- [Home & Kitchen](https://www.amazon.ae/s?i=kitchen): Home goods, cookware, furniture, and kitchen essentials.
- [Books](https://www.amazon.ae/books-used-books-textbooks/b/?ie=UTF8&node=11497745031): Books, textbooks, and reading-related products.
- [Toys & Games](https://www.amazon.ae/s?i=toys): Toys, games, hobbies, and children’s products.

## Orders, Returns & Customer Service
- [Your Orders](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/css/order-history): Order history, shipment tracking, invoices, and returns initiation.
- [Customer Service](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/help/customer/display.html): Central help hub for orders, payments, devices, and account issues.
- [Returns Centre](https://www.amazon.ae/returns): Start returns, print labels, and manage refund requests.
- [Track Package](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GCU8BWGTQNJKQEBS): Help for tracking deliveries and shipment status updates.
- [Delivery Rates and Times](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=G6BH4Y5KQW9J8K7F): Information about shipping options, delivery speed, and fees.
- [About Our Returns Policies](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GKM69DUUYKQWKWX7): Return eligibility, timelines, and refund policy details.

## Payments, Gift Cards & Preferences
- [Your Account](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/css/homepage.html): Manage profile, addresses, payments, orders, and account settings.
- [Your Payments](https://www.amazon.ae/cpe/yourpayments/wallet): Manage saved cards, payment methods, and wallet settings.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.amazon.ae/gift-cards/b/?ie=UTF8&node=15133245031): Buy, send, redeem, and manage Amazon.ae gift cards.
- [Reload Your Balance](https://www.amazon.ae/b?node=21538846031): Add funds to your Amazon balance for future purchases.
- [Customer Preferences](https://www.amazon.ae/customer-preferences/edit): Update language, currency, and regional shopping preferences.
- [Manage Addresses](https://www.amazon.ae/a/addresses): Add, edit, and organize delivery addresses for your account.

## Selling on Amazon.ae
- [Sell on Amazon](https://sell.amazon.ae/): Seller entry point for listing products and growing a business on Amazon.ae.
- [Seller Central](https://sellercentral.amazon.ae/): Seller account portal for inventory, orders, advertising, and performance.
- [Fulfilment by Amazon](https://sell.amazon.ae/programs/fulfillment-by-amazon): Logistics program for storage, packing, shipping, and customer service.
- [Amazon Advertising for Sellers](https://advertising.amazon.com/en-ae/solutions/products/sponsored-products): Sponsored Products advertising to promote listings in Amazon search and detail pages.
- [Seller University](https://sell.amazon.ae/learn): Educational resources for starting and operating an Amazon selling business.

## Business, Devices & Digital Services
- [Amazon Business](https://business.amazon.ae/): Business purchasing solution for organizations, procurement, and multi-user accounts.
- [Kindle Store](https://www.amazon.ae/kindle-dbs/storefront): Ebooks and Kindle reading content available through Amazon.
- [Appstore for Android](https://www.amazon.ae/mobile-apps/b/?ie=UTF8&node=21897168031): Android apps and digital downloads available through Amazon.
- [Amazon Photos](https://www.amazon.ae/b?node=21496087031): Photo storage service information for Amazon customers.
- [Amazon Music](https://www.amazon.ae/music/player): Music streaming and listening destination on Amazon.

## Help, Policies & Legal
- [Help Home](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/help/customer/display.html): Main support portal for customer questions and self-service tools.
- [Shipping and Delivery](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GZXW7X6AKTHNUP6H): Help content covering shipping methods and delivery expectations.
- [Amazon.ae Privacy Notice](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GX7NJQ4ZB8MHFRNJ): Privacy practices for data collection, use, and customer rights.
- [Conditions of Use](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GLSBYFE9MGKKQXXM): Terms governing use of Amazon.ae services and content.
- [Interest-Based Ads](https://www.amazon.ae/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201909010): Information about advertising preferences and personalized ads.
- [Recalls and Product Safety Alerts](https://www.amazon.ae/your-product-safety-alerts): Safety notices, recalls, and product alert information.
